Goal: Resolve failing checks and functional bugs in the skynet service so the PR passes CI and can be merged cleanly.
Scope: Only modify files under services/skynet and any shared libs that are explicitly required to fix tests or build errors. Do not change production secrets, CI tokens, or unrelated services.
Constraints:

Preserve git history and create small, focused commits (one logical change per commit).

Add tests for any behavioral fix. If a test cannot be added quickly, add a clear TODO test with a short justification.

Use existing project style and linters; run cargo fmt and cargo clippy before committing.
Steps to follow (in order):

Run the repository build and tests locally using the same toolchain as CI. If Rust toolchain is missing, install via rustup and set stable.

Use the provided code search queries (below) to find likely failure points (panic sites, unwraps, deprecated APIs, feature flags).

For each failing test or compile error: create a branch fix/skynet/<short-desc>, implement the minimal fix, add or update tests, run cargo test, run cargo clippy -- -D warnings, run cargo fmt --all. Commit with message fix(skynet): <short description> and push.

Open a PR titled fix(skynet): <short description> with a description that lists: failing CI job names, root cause, files changed, test coverage added, and a short rollback plan.

Add the PR checklist (below) as a PR description checklist and request review from CODEOWNERS for services/skynet.
If multiple independent fixes are needed, create one PR per logical fix.  
If a fix requires infra or secret changes, stop and add a PR comment describing the required infra change; do not modify secrets in code.
